## Products (currently live)

- [Kelaro](https://kelaro.io): Accounting-automation SaaS for fractional CFOs and accountants. Ingests bank PDFs and Open Banking (PSD2) feeds, runs deterministic extraction via Temporal-orchestrated pipeline, emits accountant-ready datasets. Active pilots in Portugal and Netherlands.
- [Augur](https://tryaugur.eu): GRC (Governance, Risk, Compliance) tooling for AI governance, targeting EU-regulated buyers. Full EU data residency by design. Phase 0: landing live, lead capture wired.
- Koa: Deterministic PDF bank-statement extraction engine. Three components — Python/FastAPI engine with pdfplumber + OCR fallback (Tesseract / PaddleOCR), Next.js + Prisma mapper UI for per-bank templates, isolated PII scrub container. Powers Kelaro's extraction pipeline.

## Infrastructure

All three products run on a single Hetzner CCX23 VPS. Stack: Nginx, Docker, PostgreSQL 16, Temporal, ImprovMX (inbound mail), Brevo SMTP (transactional), self-hosted Umami (analytics).

- Integrations: Stripe, OAuth 2.0, Open Banking (PSD2), Brevo, Umami
